_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Certification Requirements Plan (CRP)
summary: The Certification Requirements Plan (CRP) defines the requirements, assigns the roles and responsibilities, and defines the activities and tasks required to achieve nuclear certification.
use_relationship:
The Certification Requirements Plan (CRP) defines the requirements, assigns the roles and responsibilities, and defines all of the activities and tasks required to achieve nuclear certification. The CRP is tailored to meet the needs of a particular acquisition or modification effort. As program changes are encountered and incorporated into the acquisition or modification effort, their impact on the nuclear certification process is reviewed and the CRP is updated accordingly. The Program Manager (PM)-approved CRP contains the details regarding how and when the program office will meet the certification requirements.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation or contract. This DID is related to DI-NUOR-81888, Nuclear Certification Impact Statement (NCIS); Air Force Instruction (AFI) 63-125, Nuclear Certification Program; AFI 91-103, Air Force Nuclear Safety Design Certification Program; MIL-STD-1822, Nuclear Compatibility Certification of Nuclear Weapon Systems, Subsystems and Support Equipment; and the Nuclear Certification Impact Statement (NCIS) Coordination Form available from AFNWC/NTS.
(Copies of AFIs are available online at http://www.e-publishing.af.mil/. Copies of the NCIS and NCIS Coordination Forms can be obtained from: AFNWC/NTS, 1553 Wyoming Blvd. SE, and Bldg. 20332S, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624 or via e-mail from: AFNWC/NTSC Workflow.)
This DID supersedes DI-NUOR-81409A.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content:
The Basic CRP provided by AFNWC/NTS shall be used.
(Copies of the Basic CRP can be obtained from: AFNWC/NTS, 1553 Wyoming Blvd. SE, and Bldg. 20332S, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624 or via e-mail from: AFNWC/NTSC Workflow.)

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The CRP shall define how and when the requirements contained in the Basic CRP will be met, including assigning the roles and responsibilities for all of the activities and tasks required to achieve nuclear certification. The CRP is tailored to meet the needs of the particular acquisition or modification effort including a schedule of the required events. The CRP shall include the following:

children.title: The Compliance Matrix, included in the Basic CRP
children.content:
The Compliance Matrix, included in the Basic CRP, will show specific requirements of Air Force Manual (AFMAN) 91-118, Safety, Design and Evaluation Criteria for Nuclear Weapon Systems; AFMAN 91-119, Safety Design and Evaluation Criteria for Nuclear Weapon Systems Software; and Facilities Criteria (FC) Air Force Nuclear Weapons-Capable Maintenance and Storage Facilities, FC 4-420-07F, for which compliance must be achieved.
(Copies of the AFMANs are available online at http://www.e-publishing.af.mil/. Copies of the compliance matrices and FC 4-420-07F are available from AFNWC/NTS, 1552 Wyoming Blvd. SE, and Bldg. 20332S, Kirtland AFB, NM 87117-5624 or via e-mail from: AFNWC/NTSC Workflow.)
